EnvironmentSettings.description:
Geographic anchor for the daylight layer (PRD FR-22).

Latitude/longitude feed the solar-position model; the sun direction is
expressed relative to ``SceneDocument.north`` so rotating the compass
rotates the shadows with it. ``None`` keeps the scene on studio lighting.

PhotoImportResponse.description:
Draft scene parsed from a floor-plan photo (PRD FR-19).

The document is *not* saved: the client previews it, lets the user fix
names/types, then POSTs it to ``/api/scenes/import`` to create the scene.

post.description:
Hot-reload ``fixtures/catalog.json`` and refresh live scene validators.

The new catalog is validated against every live scene before it is applied,
so a reload that removes an in-use kind cannot silently break editing.
